_about: A one-handed sword attack shaped by dense key poses, the whole route of docs/motions/one_handed_weapon_attack.md: legs and hips from the model through the key poses, `upper_body` takes spine, arms and hands from the poses (tangents: faster into the strike, braking after it; two breakdown poses of the sword arm keep the blade off the face), `head` locks the head forward, then the recipes in order: swing_arm solves the sword arm again under the sword's path, one_hand_weapon puts the sword and the fist on it.

phases.text: A person stands in a fighting stance with the left foot forward, then raises the right arm high above the right shoulder and holds it there for a moment.
The person swings the right arm hard down and across the body to the left, the front knee bending as the hips turn into the cut.
The person lets the right arm carry on low past the left hip, then sweeps it up across the front of the body and back over the right shoulder.
The person lowers the right arm and settles back into the fighting stance, and holds the guard.
